svg.title: System design: request path across two Google Cloud zones
svg.desc: Step 1: the browser sends a request to the nginx ingress in us-central1-a. Step 2: nginx forwards it to backend-a in zone A or backend-b in zone B in turn. Step 3: the stateless Spring Boot backend queries the PostgreSQL Citus coordinator in zone A, where all tables are stored today. Dashed lines show the planned step of sharding orders by restaurant_id across db-worker-1 and db-worker-2. A monitoring node in zone A runs Prometheus, Loki and Grafana.
